topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
consensus_response: Prioritizing high-revenue services degrades navigation link budgets due to reduced EIRP, Doppler shift, and latency. Mitigation strategies include OFDM, adaptive modulation, and beamforming to optimize signal strength and reduce interference. Balancing service prioritization and navigation reliability is crucial for system performance.
reference_context: Link budgets are affected by power constraints, antenna gains, and interference, requiring proper satellite antenna gains and link characteristic identification for reliable transmission.
